caption: Two friends sit in the back seat of a car, chatting, when the car brakes hard and both of them are thrown forward against their seat belts.
A woman standing in the aisle of a bus holding the overhead rail sways backward as the bus pulls away from the stop.
A dog sprints across a smooth kitchen floor toward its food bowl, tries to stop in front of it, and skids past the bowl.
A spinning top is set going on a wooden table and left alone; it spins for a while, starts to wobble, and finally topples over.
A full cup of coffee sits in the cup holder of a car, and as the car turns sharply left the coffee sloshes up the right side of the cup and spills over the rim.
A man shakes out a wet umbrella with a quick flick and stops his arm short, and the water drops fly off the tip and keep going in the direction of the flick.
A child gives a shopping cart a push across an empty parking lot and lets go, and the cart rolls on by itself until it slows to a stop.
A family sits in the back seat of a car as it takes a sharp bend on a country road, and all of them lean toward the outside of the bend.
A woman is jogging on a treadmill when the belt stops abruptly, and she lurches forward and grabs the handrails.
A parent gives a child on a playground swing one push and steps back, and the swing keeps going back and forth on its own before gradually dying down.
A phone lying flat on the dashboard of a car slides forward toward the windshield when the driver brakes suddenly at a red light.
A man on a ladder hands a hammer down to a helper, the helper misses it, and the hammer falls to the ground.
A woman carrying groceries loses her grip on a bag of oranges at the top of a staircase, and the oranges tumble down the stairs to the bottom.
A cat nudges a pen off the edge of a desk with its paw and the pen falls to the floor.
A waiter carrying a tray of full water glasses stops abruptly to avoid a running child, and the water sloshes forward and spills.
A ceiling fan running at full speed is switched off at the wall, and the blades keep turning for a while before coming to a stop.
A boy takes a short run-up on a field, leaps forward off one foot, and after landing on both feet takes a few stumbling steps forward before he stops.
An adult pulling a toddler in a wagon stops walking suddenly, and the wagon rolls on a little and the toddler tips forward in the seat.
Autumn leaves come loose from a tree on a still afternoon and drift down to settle on the lawn.
A waiter's hand slips, a ceramic plate drops from waist height onto a tiled restaurant floor, and it shatters.
A child lets go of a helium balloon on a string in a park and the balloon floats up into the sky.
A boy tosses a tennis ball straight up in his backyard and it comes back down into his open hands.
A bowler releases the ball at the top of the lane and it rolls the full length of the lane to the pins at the far end.
A skateboarder riding along a sidewalk hits a raised crack, the board stops dead, and the rider is thrown forward off the board.
A gardener turns a watering can upside down over a flower bed and the water pours out onto the soil.
A stack of coins on the corner of a kitchen counter is knocked off by someone's elbow and the coins scatter on the floor.
A child on a sled slides down a snowy slope, runs out onto a flat patch of bare grass, and stops within a short distance.
A jogger comes to a wide puddle on a path, jumps over it, and lands on the far side.
A cook cracks an egg on the rim of a bowl, pulls the shell apart above it, and the yolk and white drop into the bowl.
A skydiver steps out of the open door of an airplane and drops away below it.
A large dog on a leash spots a squirrel and lunges after it; the leash snaps taut, the dog is stopped short, and the owner is jerked forward a step.
A rubber ball rolls across a polished wooden floor onto a thick shaggy rug and comes to a stop on the rug.
A driver tries to pull away from a snow-covered kerb, the car's rear wheels spin in place and throw up snow, and the car stays almost where it is.
A gymnast lands feet-first in the centre of a trampoline, the mat stretches deep under her, and it throws her back up into the air.
A referee flips a coin into the air at the start of a match and catches it as it comes down.
A diver stands at the end of a high platform, bends her knees, jumps off, and falls into the pool.
A man throws a dart at a dartboard on a pub wall and it sticks in the board.
A boy drops a stone into a still garden pond; it splashes, sinks, and ripples spread out across the water.
A woman hangs a basket of wet laundry from the middle of a clothesline strung between two posts, and the line sags under the weight.
A woman in smooth-soled shoes steps onto a patch of ice on a sidewalk, her foot slides forward, and she stumbles.
A child holds a kite string as a steady wind lifts the kite, and the string pulls taut from her hand up to the kite.
A worker pours a bucket of gravel slowly onto one spot on a flat concrete floor, and the gravel piles up into a cone.
A tennis racket strikes a ball hard during a serve and the ball flies off toward the far court.
A horse and rider gallop toward a low fence, jump over it, and land on the far side.
A baker presses the heel of her hand into a ball of bread dough on a floured counter and the dough flattens and spreads.
A horse gallops across an open field from one end to the other.
A cook pours olive oil into a glass of water, and the oil gathers in a layer floating on top of the water.
A man lowers a bucket into a well on a rope and hauls it back up full of water.
A motorboat speeds across a calm lake, leaving a spreading wake behind it.
A woman folds a letter into thirds and slides it into an envelope.
A woman tips a box of dry pasta into a pot of boiling water, and the pasta sinks and settles at the bottom.
A cat digs in a litter box with its front paws, flinging litter backward and leaving a hollow.
A person sits down on a large cardboard box in a garage, the box caves in under them, and it stays crumpled when they stand up.
A cat crouches on a kitchen floor, jumps up onto the counter, and lands on it.
A woman bends down, picks up a heavy box from the floor, and straightens up holding it.
A woman tips a jar of honey over a slice of toast, and the honey flows out in a slow thick ribbon onto the toast.
A cashier tears a sheet of wrapping paper from a roll and folds it around a shoebox, creasing the corners.
A child pulls a blanket off a bed and drags it across the floor behind her.
A child drags a stick through a patch of loose gravel on a path, leaving a furrow behind it.
A boy catches a ball thrown to him with both hands and holds on to it.
A boy drops a water balloon from a second-floor balcony, and it falls straight down and bursts on the pavement.
A ball rolls across a living-room floor, disappears behind a sofa, and comes out the other side.
A coin is set spinning on its edge on a wooden table, wobbles, and falls flat.
A goalkeeper punts a soccer ball far down the field, and it lands and bounces near the far end.
A man sits down in an empty hammock strung between two trees, and the hammock sags deeply under him.
A child bends a fresh green twig into a curve, lets go of one end, and the twig springs back to nearly straight.
A man tilts a half-full fish tank to one side while carrying it, and the water climbs the low side and spills over the rim.
A boy blows up a balloon, lets go of the neck without tying it, and the balloon shoots off around the room until it drops limp to the floor.
A swimmer does front crawl across a pool and reaches the far wall.
A woman puts a set of keys into a small wooden box, closes the lid, then opens it again and takes the keys out.
